name: freelens-extension-kit
description: The method for building a Freelens extension with an AI coding agent

releases.name: v0.1.5
releases.body: Scope is added to an approved roadmap by a decision of the maintainer, on a proposal of where it goes, what it changes in what is done and its facts, with a new source read at a release tag and a commit before any spec uses it, and the decision is recorded under "Changes of scope" in the roadmap; a probe of what the source leaves open runs beside the first round of review of a spec, its facts are written into the spec as numbered facts, and a rule that waits for it keeps a fallback and no mark at the approval; a draft that designs a view expects about four rounds of review, the last one narrow.

releases.name: v0.1.4
releases.body: Freelens is read at every release that `engines.freelens` admits; a list hands the host a store that selects and removes nothing, and stays live through the host's own subscription; the screenshots of a view come before its review, and a test of the stylesheets holds a cell to one line; a draft that designs how the views read the cluster expects about four rounds of review, each after the first on the diff of the last revision, and the reviewer of a diff gets the log of the checks seen failing; a session in Freelens written where it cannot run goes to CI at once, CI can take the screenshots of the themes, a check that nothing was written records the session's own writes from the answer of the server, the checks at the end of a session report every failure, and a hover or a click waits for the host to apply an input; a long step on a second machine runs in the foreground of a remote command of its own.

releases.name: v0.1.3
releases.body: The reconnaissance asks about the host and says how a large project is read; a reviewer leaves the index of git alone and a long report is saved to the notes; the roadmap can be approved in words and has a row for the pass before a milestone review; a health is never held while an operation is in flight; a captured fixture waits for its state to settle and is cleaned of the capture machine; an expected error is left out narrowly.

releases.name: v0.1.2
releases.body: `docs/repository.md` says how a new repository follows the standard of its organization, with the ruleset of the default branch last, and three things the repository holds before its first spec that the `create-extension` skill does not say.

releases.name: v0.1.1
releases.body:
The brief asks the maintainer whether a rule of the template that restricts
a model stays, or is replaced by the rule of choosing the model for the
task.

releases.name: v0.1.0
releases.body:
The first version of the Freelens extension kit: the method for building a
Freelens extension with an AI coding agent, from the first brief to the
release.

## What is in it

- `AGENTS.md`: the path of an extension in ten steps, and the rules that hold
  at every step.
- `docs/`: one document for each step, from the brief to maintenance; two
  optional ones, on the README of an extension with its screenshots and
  video, and on dividing the work among machines, coding agents and models;
  and how an extension written in the community becomes an official one.
- `templates/`: the brief, the session notes, the roadmap, the three forms of
  a spec, the method sections for the `AGENTS.md` of an extension, a task
  brief, the report of the pre-review pass and the outcome of a review.
- `skills/build-extension`: a thin pointer to `AGENTS.md`, in the Agent
  Skills format.

## Status

- Last checked against Freelens 2.1.0 and against the template at commit
  `5c75d60`.
- Proven with Claude Code. For GitHub Copilot, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and
  OpenCode it follows what their documentation says.
- The kit is being proven on the first extension built with it, for Cluster
  API.

## Using it

Start from "How to use it" in the README. An extension names the version of
the kit it follows in its `AGENTS.md`:
`https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-extension-kit/tree/v0.1.0`.
